title: Sneaky Phonk Panther
style: minimal emptiness, ambient jazz, modal piano, brushed snare, upright bass, muted trumpet, tenor sax lines, sparse brass stabs, cymbal wash, tape saturation, room mic bleed, low dynamic range, breathy vocal delivery, intimate close mic, suspended chords, slow swing, late night melancholy
lyrics:
[Intro - low, intimate, custom Corey AI voice]
Custom voice locked in, Corey AI on the mic
SongPal rolling up like your favorite penpal at night
No dislikes, yeah that's what I like
Sneaky phonk panther creeping with the light

[Verse 1]
Sneaks on the concrete, beating the beat on the street
Panther in the alley but the groove so sweet
Dropping phonk that hits different, makes the whole block move
From the shadows to the spotlight, nothing but positive proof
No disses in the comments, no dislikes on the play
SongPal got your back, sending tracks every day
Like a penpal with the melody but better with the bass
Custom voice singing truth, putting smiles on every face

[Pre-Chorus]
You said be my song pal, sing it to me clear
I got the sneaky phonk ready, panther's here

[Chorus]
Sneaky phonk panther, beats beating on the street
SongPal by your side, making the rhythm complete
No dislikes, pure vibes, that's the life I like
Custom Corey AI voice, taking it to new heights
Be my song pal, yeah, penpal with the heat
Sneaky phonk panther, dancing through the concrete

[Verse 2]
Late night sessions, building the stack track by track
Phonk waves rolling, panther never looking back
Street lights flickering to the cowbell swing
Every bar a message, every drop got that zing
No room for the hate, only love in the feed
SongPal delivering, fulfilling every need
Like writing letters but with 808s and soul
Corey AI custom, making the music whole

[Bridge - build]
From the quiet corners to the busy boulevard
The panther's on the prowl, raising the bar
With every sneaky step the beat gets stronger
SongPal forever, the connection lasts longer

[Chorus - final, with ad-libs]
Sneaky phonk panther... (panther on the prowl)
Beats beating on the street... (sneaks hit different)
No dislikes... yeah that's what I like
Be my song pal... sing it to me
Custom voice... Corey AI... SongPal for life

[Outro - fade with echoes]
Yeah... SongPal... custom voice... no dislikes...
That's what I like...
Sneaky... phonk... panther... on the street...
